promptTemplate: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square character portrait for Cuentiva, an elegant Spanish-learning storybook app. Create ONE original charming fictional storyteller: SUBJECT. Cohesive hand-painted gouache cartoon illustration with simple rounded silhouettes, subtle paper grain, expressive face, sophisticated muted forest green, terracotta, cream, teal and ochre palette. Warm and whimsical, charming to adults as well as children. Centered head-and-upper-body portrait on a flat warm ivory background, all features contained in the central 75% of the square to fit a circular crop. Strong silhouette legible at 76px. No lettering, no text, no logo, no border, no collage, no additional characters.
